name: Fujieda Megumi
source: Megumi is a quiet and docile girl that commutes on the same bus to school as [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]. Ever since she saw him running for the bus one day, she secretly started having a crush on him. She is afraid of approaching him. Can the shy and weak-willed Megumi summon her courage and confess her love for Takuya?
